scope: Prospective local confirmation and competitive-route studies; software assembly and observed behavior are separate acceptance levels.

model.broader_4096_tensor_family: Not implemented, not used, and not assigned the reference component results.

definitions.signal: A declared initial source disturbance whose later causal effect is established by a matched source-absent complete trajectory. Nominal distance alone is not an observed arrival.
definitions.arrival: Record separately the first source-counterfactual change of the six signed receiver input terms, the first net-input change, and the record/C-bearing update.
definitions.C_channel: Unchanged reference classifier: nonzero quotient ell=b_next+a_old and an actual change of the complete channel triple. Keep every channel event and its arithmetic class.
definitions.C_node: At least one C_channel among all 48 channels of a declared receiver or outlet node in the same update. This grouping does not delete coincident channel events.
definitions.R: A change of the predeclared receiver remainder pair M=(r0,r14). R alone is not a guarded arithmetic click.
definitions.memory: A predeclared passive function of existing complete triples, with a fixed retention interval and source controls; no extra dynamical register.
definitions.waiting: The declared local record persists with no receiver-node C during the fixed interval. Other board nodes may evolve and may produce C events.
definitions.confirmation: A subsequent autonomous arrival is necessary for a receiver-node C under the four initial-source masks. A two-arrival coincidence device is not proof that a route is unique or that an internal apparatus computed that fact.
definitions.route_uniqueness: Within fixed outlet-node windows, exactly the predicted route has a guarded C-bearing output while the other outlet's full 48-channel triples equal its matching no-source baseline. This is a finite apparatus readout, not global path erasure.
definitions.cooperation_metric: C_pair is the exact fraction of nonzero coordinates of a two-site mixed-response vector. It measures calibrated nonadditivity, not entropy, periodicity, order or physical complexity. It is never read by the evolution engine.

confirmation_study.question: Can one prepared arrival write a retained waiting remainder record without any receiver-node C, and a second independently preloaded arrival then create the only receiver-node C?
confirmation_study.deliverable: Frozen case protocol, every tested preparation/result, selected full-state traces, exact inverse audits, and fresh confirmation if any exploratory candidate passes.
pass: Each source alone: exactly one M change from(2,4) to(4,2) in its fixed[d_i,d_i+1]window, retained throughH, with zero C_node throughH.
Both sources: M=(2,4)->(4,2)->(0,0), first change in[d1,d1+1], second in[d2,d2+3]; no extra R changes.
Pending record persists for at least four complete updates, with zero receiver-node C and the declared zero-input interval; receiver counter values during pending satisfy the frozen case criterion.
Exactly one C_node-bearing update in the both-source run, coincident with the second M change; all 48 receiver channels checked over the entire horizon.
Actual input terms distinguish the first event from source-2-only and the second event from source-1-only; retain exact input evidence rather than assuming arrival from distance.
Complete forward/inverse checks, full rewind, and an initial nonbackground boundary margin greater thanH.
confirmation_study.failure: Any fixed behavioral criterion fails: retain its counterexample. Completing the finite family with no passing candidates is a finite negative result, not impossibility.
confirmation_study.continue: If a candidate passes, use the first in the frozen candidate order; register at least three fresh distance pairs with all four masks before any holdout execution. Require the same criteria. Otherwise report the obstruction observed in this family before proposing another search.

route_study.question: Does a prospectively calibrated two-site cooperation score predict a unique surviving outlet among individually transmitting prepared routes, including comparisons with matched isolated arrival times?
route_study.deliverable: Frozen calibration and joint-case manifests, all outcomes and null/tie/swap controls, latency-stratified prediction report, and fresh confirmation of any selected competitive component.
route_study.exploratory_family: Equal six-site +/-X arms, variable remainder-pair sites2 and3, each independently O=(4,0),N=(2,2),R=(0,4); nine ordered two-site patterns per side, all81 ordered joint pattern pairs. One common initially prepared unit probe; no runtime source insertion.

primary_metric.readout_vector: All48 outlet b values at every step6..15, in fixed(time,channel)order; vectorlength480.
primary_metric.perturbation: At each of the two variable sites independently, replace r0 by(r0+2)mod6 and r14 by4-r0_new; preserve initial zero counters.
primary_metric.mixed_response: D=Y_both-Y_site2-Y_site3+Y_base from four isolated calibration runs with identical source phase, geometry and fixed tensor.
primary_metric.score: C_pair=count(D_coordinate!=0)/480, stored exactly as numerator and denominator.
primary_metric.binary_diagnostic_only: WhetherD!=0 may also be reported. It cannot replace or rerank the primary score after observing joint outcomes.
primary_metric.old_K_study: The earlier54-run K prediction remains failed in its original family. This is a separately registered paired-preparation and graded-metric study.

controls: same source phase and initial amplitude

arrival_control.record: For every isolated base arm, retain first full-triple outlet difference, first nonzero b response, and first C_node-bearing update using all48 channels.
arrival_control.primary_eligible: Both isolated routes transmit b and have C_node, primary scores are unequal, and their isolated arrival triples(first_any_change,first_b,first_C)are identical.
arrival_control.unmatched: Retain descriptively as prepared competition. Earlier arrival or phase may explain a winner; these cases do not support the primary complexity-preference claim.
arrival_control.no_eligible: Inconclusive for the matched-arrival prediction, never a vacuous pass.

route_study.primary_prediction: Every eligible unequal-score joint pair has at least one C_node at the higher-score outlet and complete all48(a,b,r)baseline equality at the lower-score outlet for every sample6..40; the swapped comparison must satisfy the corresponding label prediction.
route_study.failure: Any eligible counterexample rejects the stated finite-family prediction. Keep ties, both-output cases, quiet cases and latency mismatches. One passing pair does not rescue a failed universal prediction.
route_study.component_gate: A pair that transmits separately and gives only one joint outlet may be retained as a prepared competitive component even when no cooperation-selection law is supported; fresh confirmation is still required.
route_study.continue: Register deterministic candidate selection and fresh lengths/phases/observation windows before holdout runs. Do not redefine calibration, readouts or score to accommodate a result. A path-generated confirmation apparatus is a later separate composition test.

shared_verification.budget_exhaustion: Inconclusive; preserve completed cases and the stop reason, never claim all registered cases passed.
shared_verification.finite_positive_scope: Only declared preparations, coupling, board and horizons; no physical-light identification, Born rule, path erasure or irreversible microscopic time.
shared_verification.assembly_regression: New generic preparation/runner code must reproduce historical44 component runs and all1868 complete states before its reused components inherit those bounded results.
